searchLog: Read profile.md, target-companies.json (29 companies), sent-log.json (last ~40 opportunity titles, to avoid repeats), applications.json (empty), and life/PIPELINE.md (in-flight, excluded from consideration: Claude Corps, Ford FCG, Red Ventures, TikTok, Goldman Sachs, CIL, MIT Future Fest, MLH, Horizon, 3x Adobe reqs). Also confirmed the graduation-date conflict flagged in this run's brief no longer exists -- life/PROFILE.md shows it was resolved to December 2026 on 2026-08-04, matching morning-briefing/profile.md. WebSearch worked and surfaced live leads (e.g. Anthropic Applied AI Architect reqs, Claude Corps Cohort 3 reopening ~Sept 2026 -- already tracked in PIPELINE). WebFetch was completely non-functional this run: every fetch attempt returned EGRESS_BLOCKED, tested against api.ashbyhq.com, job-boards.greenhouse.io, www.anthropic.com, and https://example.com as a control -- a total environment-level egress block, not a per-site policy. This is the identical failure mode as the 2026-09-08 run (second consecutive day). hunt.md's verification rule requires confirming from the actual page that applications are open and the user is eligible -- a search snippet or aggregator listing is explicitly disallowed as sole evidence. With no working fetch, no candidate could be verified, so nothing is included. Zero verified opportunities is the honest and correct output, not a sign nothing was findable.
